pages.title: Weight loss injections under scrutiny - JCCP
h2: Negative aspects of weight loss injections
Warning from MHRA of dangerous counterfeit weight loss pens
Advertising regulations for Prescription Only Medicines (POM)

- If you plan to purchase weight loss injections online, you should choose a pharmacy registered in the UK. You can check the pharmacy’s registration on the GPhC website. You should expect to provide all the necessary medical information, including evidence of height and weight.

- If you purchase weight loss injections from an individual, you should have a face-to-face assessment with a prescriber. You can check that they are a registered prescriber by visiting the relevant professional regulator website such as the GMC, NMC, GDC, GPhC or HCPC.
- In either case, you should ensure that you are provided with sufficient information, including all the risks as well as benefits, to make an informed decision.
pages.open: Unveiling the risks: Weight loss injections under scrutiny Introduction Weight loss injections are a medical treatment designed to aid in weight reduction. These injections work by suppressing appetite, increasing feelings of fullness, and delaying gastric emptying.
